# betizzi

> betizzi (betizzi.com) is a free football (soccer) tips site in 9 languages. It filters each day's matches and publishes tips only where its statistics-based model finds a reason, plus ready-made parlays and a public, unedited track record of every tip since 2 November 2026 (wins and losses). It does not promise profit; tips are not a guarantee. 18+ (21+ in Greece).

## What betizzi offers
- Daily football tips (Free and VIP) with a short reason based on recent form, goals and league standings, and the odds at the time of publication.
- Ready parlays in fixed odds zones (about x3–5, x8–12, x20–30 and the mega parlay of the day, x30–50), built only from betizzi's own tips.
- "Strongest of the day": three picks published every morning (Athens time, between 08:00 and 14:00).
- A public Record page: every published tip with result, win rate and ROI by league, odds range and bet type. Published tips are never edited or deleted; since 2 November 2026 they are not withdrawn either (a few withdrawn before that rule stay listed in the Record).
- Match pages for each match, kept after full time with the result (✓ won / ✗ lost; postponed = void).
